author: cinammoncroc000
body:
Hello (*@^_^@*)

I've had this idea for quite a while and I posted it on another topic, but unfortunately no one's reply had anything to do with what I said so I'm guessing no one really payed attention.
I try :T

Anyways, my idea is the introduction of XP Multiplier Events. I know that many servers have a very similar concept implemented into their servers, but I thought that this server would benefit greatly from it as well.

What it is:
Basically, on a given day, you would recieve 2 or 3 times the XP you would normally get for one specific minigame. For example, let's say we had an XP Multiplier Event for Nebula on a random day in the year. For 24 hours, everyone who played that minigame would gain 2 or 3 times the XP they would normally get (ex. if I killed someone, I would get 4-6 XP. If I broke a monument, I would get 14-21 XP.)

In my head, the main purpose of these events would be to draw players to a certain minigame. If a minigame like Avicade or Elimination had an event like this, people would be drawn to that minigame because they would gain more XP. Once people try that minigame, they would (hopefully) find it fun and play that minigame again.

It's obviously not a perfect idea, but I would like to see what your opinions on it would be :)

replies.author: _DC
replies.body:
Well you could add the EXP separately so donators do not get a massive boost. For instance:
(M = eventmodifier, D = donator modifier, XP = xp amount being given) 

XP = 5; M = 3; D = 2;

FairEXP = XP*D+XP*M = 25
NotFairEXP = XP*D*M = 30

This would be fair for every user and only give the 1.5-2.5x donator exp boost rather than doubling it or tripling it with the added daily bonus(3-5x donator boost for double eventbonus).

+1
